title: Battle of Kircholm
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kircholm", at revision 1376914248, opens: "The Battle of Kircholm took place on 27 September [O.S. 17 September] 1605 during the Polish–Swedish War (1600–1611) near Kircholm, now Salaspils in Latvia. A Swedish expedition besieging Riga was defeated by a smaller Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth relief force and abandoned the attempt." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q937332, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1605 major battle of the Polish–Swedish War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
